capabilities: inject a live clock into the Calendar plugin panel
inherit theme colors and fonts via Obsidian CSS variables
keep the layout stable with a monospace font
disambiguation: It is not a calendar replacement; it only adds a clock above the Calendar plugin and does nothing without it.
extras: Manual installation only (download main.js and manifest.json from GitHub Releases); the README notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: injects a live clock directly into the top of Liam Cain's Calendar plugin interface
motivation: The author wants a clock near the daily note calendar that survives Calendar plugin updates, hence shipping it as a separate plugin.
problem: The Calendar plugin shows dates but no current time, and CSS tweaks made directly to it get overwritten on plugin updates.

relations.evidence: injects a live clock directly into the top of Liam Cain's Calendar plugin interface

summary: UI companion that injects a live, customizable clock into the top of Liam Cain's Calendar plugin panel.
